topic: Moving inventory data from staging to production
summary_markdown: The participants confirmed that the numbers for both traffic and mall metrics were identical across all periods, starting from September. Later, a request was made to move the inventory data for '7881 Ivoiry' covering the entire period (since 2022-09-01) from the staging environment to production. This transfer was completed.
decisions: Inventory data for 7881 Ivoiry, spanning from September 2022, will be moved from staging to production.
